metadata.title: Don't Wear the Matriarch's Pearl Bracelet
metadata.subtitle: She stole my late mother-in-law’s heirloom jewels before the gala—at 3AM nine knocks rattled her suite while the hallway stood empty.

nodes.text: 1:12 AM · Grand Harbor Hotel, eve of your engagement gala. Lydia—Adrian’s wealthy cousin’s friend—drops a bragging selfie in the bridal-party chat.
Found this gorgeous 18-pearl bracelet sitting lonely in Suite 1808! Adrian’s late mother clearly had taste—it matches my silk gown way better than yours, Natalie.
You unlocked my dressing-suite safe and took Adrian’s late mother’s pearl bracelet? Put it back on the velvet cushion before 2:00 AM.
Lydia, seriously, that bracelet was buried with Mom’s keepsakes for a reason—it belongs to Natalie tomorrow night. Return it now.

nodes.prompt: Lydia laughs off Adrian’s warning and locks herself in Suite 1812:

options.label: Warn her about the 3 AM nine knocks
options.player_reply_text: Adrian’s mother wore those 18 South Sea pearls every night until she passed. Anyone who steals them hears nine knocks at 3:00 AM.

options.label: Ask Maya how Lydia got into 1808
options.player_reply_text: Maya, check the Suite 1808 electronic door log. Who handed Lydia a staff pass?

nodes.text: Oooh, terrifying! I’ll sleep with earplugs, sweetie. Wait—why did the pearls just turn wet like they were pulled out of seawater?
Checking now, Miss Natalie—she bribed a temp florist to prop the service pantry door open at 12:55 AM!
1:20 AM · One single pearl on Lydia’s wrist cracks with a sharp SNAP—spilling ice-cold brine down her silk sleeve.

nodes.headline: Seventeen Pearls Left
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The clasp refuses to open—and the hotel hallway smells of salt water.

nodes.text: 2:14 AM · Fog rolls off the harbor against the 18th-floor glass. Lydia tries soap, lotion, and nail clippers—the gold clasp won’t budge.
Adrian, stop joking and send maintenance up to 1812! The pearls are freezing my pulse—my fingertips are numb!
Miss Lydia, our night engineer is standing outside 1812, but he refuses to step closer. There’s a trail of wet bare footprints leading straight to your door.
You didn’t just take the bracelet for a selfie, did you, Lydia? What else was sitting inside that velvet box?
I swapped the engagement guest-list ledger AND pocketed the Matriarch’s signed stock proxy card—nobody was supposed to check until tomorrow!

nodes.prompt: Adrian sees the unsent flash and freezes:

options.label: Ask about the Matriarch’s stock proxy
options.player_reply_text: My late mother-in-law kept her 12% preferred-stock proxy tucked under the velvet lining. Hand it over, Lydia.

options.label: Tell Maya to watch the 18th-floor CCTV
options.player_reply_text: Maya, keep your eyes locked on the Floor 18 corridor monitor as the clock approaches 3:00 AM.

nodes.text: I don’t have any stock card!! Wait—why did a second pearl just burst?!
Monitoring live now, Miss Natalie. Every single room door on this floor just fogged over with condensation.

nodes.headline: 3:00 AM Approaches
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Nine slow knocks rattle Suite 1812—while the hallway camera shows nobody there.

episodes.title: Nine Knocks in an Empty Hall

nodes.text: 3:00 AM · KNOCK. KNOCK. KNOCK. Nine heavy, unhurried raps shake the oak door of Suite 1812. Lydia screams and checks the peephole—nothing.

nodes.caption: Miss Natalie, look at the live Corridor 18 feed! The microphone picked up all nine knocks—yet the hallway is completely empty!

nodes.text: Why is there nobody on the camera?! The brass handle is rattling right now—and someone is humming Mom’s old lullaby through the keyhole!!
That’s my mother’s favorite French waltz... Lydia, tell me right now what you stole out of the velvet box!

nodes.prompt: Lydia backs up against the balcony curtains as a third pearl snaps:

options.label: Make her confess to the bridal chat
options.player_reply_text: Every time you lie, another pearl breaks, Lydia. Tell Adrian about the stock proxy before the necklace runs out.

options.label: Ask about the switched gala champagne
options.player_reply_text: And what did you pay the temp florist to slip into my gala dress hem, Lydia?

nodes.text: Fine!! I took the proxy card!! My father’s shipping firm is about to default—he told me if I got Adrian’s mother’s voting proxy, the banks would extend our loan!!
Just a tiny stain capsule so you’d run off stage!! I swear I didn’t want to hurt you—make the knocking stop!!
[sobbing into the phone] The deadbolt just turned by itself—the door is swinging open!!

nodes.headline: The Door Swings Open
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The pearls lead Lydia straight back down the empty corridor toward Suite 1808.

nodes.text: 3:14 AM · Suite 1812 stands wide open. Freezing harbor mist curls across the plush carpet as Lydia’s phone drops onto her bed—still recording.

nodes.transcript: [panicked footsteps] "My wrist is pulling me down the hall!! I’m not walking—something is leading me straight back to Suite 1808!"

nodes.text: Mr. Adrian, Miss Lydia just collapsed on her knees outside Suite 1808! She threw a folded legal proxy card under the door!
I’m stepping out of the elevator right now. Natalie, stay inside 1808 until security and I secure the hallway.

nodes.prompt: You pick up the folded stock proxy card slid beneath your door:

options.label: Check if the signature was tampered with
options.player_reply_text: Wait—Lydia already forged her father’s company seal on the transfer line at the bottom!

options.label: Open the door and face Lydia calmly
options.player_reply_text: I’m opening the door now. Let’s see how bold you feel without the dark, Lydia.

nodes.text: That’s felony corporate forgery! My mother’s lawyer is going to bury her father’s firm by noon.
Please take the bracelet off me!! Only the rightful bride can undo the gold clasp—I’m begging you!!
3:22 AM · You touch the gold clasp once. It clicks open effortlessly, sliding cool and smooth into your palm.

nodes.headline: The Clasp Answers Its Owner
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Lydia’s father storms the hotel lobby—trying to bully Adrian into silence.

nodes.text: 3:45 AM · Down in the grand lobby, Lydia’s father—Chairman Sterling—arrives with two bodyguards, demanding Maya erase the CCTV.
Miss Natalie, Mr. Sterling is threatening to pull his annual banquets if we hand the footage to police!
Listen to my dad, Natalie! Give back the proxy sheet and pretend tonight was a silly prank—or he’ll ruin your engagement press!
Your father clearly forgot who owns 60% of the Grand Harbor Hotel’s parent trust, Lydia.

nodes.prompt: Adrian steps into the lobby elevator beside you, furious:

options.label: Have Maya broadcast the confession
options.player_reply_text: Maya, upload the hallway footage, the door log, and Lydia’s voice note straight to the precinct portal.

options.label: Call Sterling’s creditor bank directly
options.player_reply_text: Adrian, ring the credit director at Harbor Bank. Ask if they know Sterling tried to pledge a stolen, forged stock proxy as collateral.

nodes.text: Uploaded and stamped with hotel legal seal! Detectives are pulling up to the valet circle now.
Just hung up with the bank VP. They’re freezing Sterling Shipping’s credit line at market open!

nodes.headline: The Forged Collateral
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Maya scans the forged stock proxy—and Sterling realizes his daughter just sank his empire.

nodes.text: 4:08 AM · Under the lobby chandeliers, Maya places the laminated scan of the forged proxy in front of the lead detective.

nodes.caption: Here is the forged transfer line bearing Sterling Shipping’s corporate stamp—lifted straight from Suite 1808.

nodes.text: Look at Sterling’s face. He’s trying to claim Lydia stamped it without his permission!
Dad?! You literally handed me the company stamp in the car!! How can you throw me under the bus?!

nodes.prompt: Father and daughter turn on each other in front of three officers:

options.label: Let the officers record every word
options.player_reply_text: Keep talking, both of you. Officer, make sure your bodycam is catching this.

options.label: Blacklist Sterling from the gala forever
options.player_reply_text: Maya, cancel their table for tonight’s engagement gala and donate their deposit to the harbor marine rescue.

nodes.text: Both Mr. Sterling and Miss Lydia are being escorted to separate squad cars now, Miss Natalie.
Already processed, ma’am! The harbor rescue charity will be thrilled.

nodes.headline: Two Squad Cars
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Back in Suite 1808, you notice something miraculous inside the velvet box.

nodes.text: 4:40 AM · Quiet returns to Suite 1808. You open the velvet box to check the three pearls that shattered on Lydia’s wrist.
Adrian... come look at the velvet cushion. Count the pearls.
All eighteen are completely whole—warm, smooth, and glowing. Not a single hairline crack.

nodes.prompt: Adrian lifts the bracelet gently and looks into your eyes:

options.label: Let him clasp it onto my wrist
options.player_reply_text: Your mother really did choose her daughter-in-law herself.

options.label: Promise to guard the family honor
options.player_reply_text: Thank you for standing by me tonight without a second of hesitation, Adrian.

nodes.text: The pearls warm instantly against your pulse, carrying the faint, comforting scent of summer lavender.
Always, Natalie. You and I against the world.

nodes.headline: Morning Over the Harbor
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning light fills the sunlit conservatory before your engagement gala.

nodes.text: 8:40 AM · Morning sun streams across the glass conservatory overlooking the blue harbor. White orchids bloom along the aisle.
Good morning, Miss Natalie! The prosecutor just confirmed Sterling and Lydia remain in custody—and your gala ballroom is picture-perfect.
Breakfast is ready on the terrace, fiancée. Ready to celebrate the real way tonight?

nodes.prompt: You admire the luminous pearl bracelet gleaming in the sunlight:

options.label: Step onto the sunny terrace with Adrian
options.player_reply_text: More than ready. Let’s enjoy our morning.

options.label: Toast to the Matriarch’s blessing
options.player_reply_text: Here’s to your mother—for always knowing who truly belongs in this family.

nodes.text: Harbor gulls wheel against a cloudless blue sky as the 18 pearls rest warmly on your wrist.
Crystal glasses clink softly in the bright morning breeze.

nodes.headline: The Matriarch’s Blessing
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "Don’t Wear the Matriarch’s Pearl Bracelet"! Explore more karma thrillers.
